title: A playthrough of a lernapps interactive app
description: A file src/playthroughs/<name>.yaml of an app built from the archetype interactive: keys a learner types, from the start of a route with a seed, and after each step what is expected: the state of the core (the fields named, compared with the state step(state, key) gives) or the announcement for screen readers (@lernapps/tooling/a11y), or both. The build plays every playthrough against the core and fails with one line per mismatch; the end-to-end tests play the same keys in the browser. Between keys the build lets no time pass, the browser does: expect only what the keys decide.

route.description: The route it starts at, an id of routes in src/app.yaml; the first route when it names none.

seed.description: The seed it starts with: start(seed, route); in the browser the address app/?seed=<seed>#<route>.

step.description: Keys, then what is expected after them: state, announce, or both.

keys.description: The keys, one after the other, each as the browser names it (KeyboardEvent.key): a, A, Enter, " " for the space bar, ArrowLeft.

state.description: The state expected after the keys: the fields named, each compared in the same way; a list or any other value is compared as a whole.

announce.description: The announcement expected after the keys, in German: what @lernapps/tooling/a11y's announce said last. Only the browser can see it.
